label: Disclaimer
body: The Illinois Criminal Justice Information Authority ('ICJIA') offers translations of the content through Google Translate. Because Google Translate is an external website, ICJIA does not control the quality or accuracy of translated content. All ICJIA content is filtered through Google Translate which may result in unexpected and unpredictable degradation of portions of text, images and the general appearance on translated pages. Google Translate may maintain unique privacy and use policies. These policies are not controlled by ICJIA and are not associated with ICJIA's privacy and use policies.
